subject: Main experiments are now E1, E2, E3b; E3a/E4/E4b/E5/E6 archived
body: Ethan's decision, 2026-11-14 (PLAN §9). E1 is a proof of concept for the user-model method. Archived experiments are not run or reported; their code and prereg drafts (results/prereg/E4.json, E5.json) stay. E3b's R0/R1 arms still need loop runs for their best designs. Workstream sections in PLAN §12 still describe the archived work; owners (David: E4/E4b/E5, Nathan: E3a/E6) please confirm what to stop.
